visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A wide shot showing a poke food stall named 'KIWI POKE' in a mall food court with teal tiled flooring and staff members behind a brightly lit counter. (2) Close-up shot of a staff member's hands in purple gloves scooping white shredded chicken into a beige ceramic bowl. (3) The camera pans across a salad bar with various metal containers as staff use tongs to add green buckwheat noodles to the bowl. (4) A rapid montage of close-ups shows different toppings being added: broccoli, corn, pineapple, crab sticks, and red kimchi. (5) A hand shakes a condiment bottle, sprinkling sesame seeds and seasoning over a bowl filled with toppings including shrimp and octopus. (6) A medium shot displays two prepared poke bowls on wooden trays, one with noodles and one with rice, accompanied by small glasses of red juice. (7) Close-up of a fork lifting a cluster of green noodles coated in a creamy sesame sauce. (8) Creamy white dressing is poured from a small bowl over the noodles and toppings. (9) A series of close-ups show various spoon and fork portions of the food: shrimp with corn, sliced hard-boiled eggs with sesame, and red sauce being poured over a rice bowl. (10) A close-up of a spoonful of rice topped with bright orange fish roe and meat. (11) A shot of two small clear glasses filled with bright red berry enzyme drink on a wooden tray. (12) A transparent square plastic bucket filled with fruit, yogurt, and cereal is shown with a handle. (13) Staff scooping thick white yogurt into the plastic bucket over pieces of fruit. (14) A staff member is seen behind the counter operating a blender filled with a pink smoothie liquid. (15) The pink smoothie is poured into a white paper cup. (16) The final shot returns to the wide view of the KIWI POKE stall with text overlays providing location details.
